description: ADR-003 Sub-decision C: when a customer opens chat while on a product PDP, Emma's reply should acknowledge the product they are viewing rather than asking a generic 'what brings you in today?' The page context line is injected as 'Customer is viewing: [Product Name]' in the known_about_customer block. Emma should NOT assume the customer wants to buy — only that they are looking at it. She may offer to help them learn more or compare options.
